title: How to File an Environmental Incident Report
summary: Step-by-step instructions for documenting and submitting hazardous ecological violations with photographic evidence and GPS accuracy.
content:
1. Ensure your personal safety before taking photos.
2. Tap "File Incident" and select the appropriate hazard classification.
3. Take clear photos showing the scale and street context.
4. Pin the exact location on the interactive GIS map.
5. Submit with verified PhilSys or Government ID to earn +10 Eco-Points.

title: Household Waste Segregation & Composting Protocol
summary: Compliance steps under Republic Act 9003 for biodegradable, recyclable, and residual household sorting.
content:
1. Keep separate bins for Biodegradable, Recyclable, and Residual waste.
2. Rinse food containers and dry plastics before storing in the recycling bin.
3. Turn organic kitchen scraps into compost using a small backyard bin or bokashi bucket.
4. Take e-waste and batteries to barangay designated recovery bins.

title: Typhoon & Heavy Storm Flash Flood Protocol
summary: Official CENRO & CDRRMO emergency steps when heavy rainfall triggers localized flood warnings.
content:
1. Monitor live PAGASA rainfall advisories and city alert levels on the dashboard.
2. Move appliances and documents to upper levels when flood waters begin rising.
3. Unplug electrical appliances from wall outlets.
4. Call the 24/7 CDRRMO Emergency Hotline (02) 8888-RESCUE if water reaches knee-level.
